name: Chevereto
description: Self-hosted image and video hosting platform for building a private image-sharing site.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      CHEVERETO_DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-mariadb"
      CHEVERETO_DB_NAME: chevereto
      CHEVERETO_DB_USER: chevereto
      CHEVERETO_DB_PASSWORD: {{env.CHEVERETO_DB_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/images:/var/www/html/images
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mariadb
  {{serviceName}}-mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mariadb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: chevereto
      MYSQL_USER: chevereto
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.CHEVERETO_DB_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.CHEVERETO_DB_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mariadb:/var/lib/mysql
